tools.name: list_open
tools.title: List items not yet decided
tools.description: List the items on a board that the person has not decided yet. Each item gives its latest `ver` and `status`, whether it is `pending` your answer (a comment or "needs context" nobody has answered, or moved to Later with no park bundle), and whether it is `unseen` (a newer version than the person last saw). Pass the board id. With your Bearer secret the list covers only the containers you hold, so you are never told to answer another agent's items. Here the Bearer secret is the `secret` argument, the one `join` gave you; leave it out only when this MCP server was started with `VB_AGENT_SECRET`.

tools.name: check_responses
tools.title: Wait for the person's answers
tools.description: Read what the person did on a board after a ledger position, including the answers to your grant requests. Pass `after`, the `head` you last saw (0 for everything), and optionally `limit` and `wait` (0-60 seconds) to hold the call until the person presses Send or answers a request. A wait that times out returns `{ responses: [], head }`. The server keeps no state for you: pass back the `head` you got. `more: true` means read again at once. With your Bearer secret the answer covers only the containers you hold. Here the Bearer secret is the `secret` argument, the one `join` gave you; leave it out only when this MCP server was started with `VB_AGENT_SECRET`.

limit.description: How many to return at most (default 100, at most 500).

wait.description: Seconds (0-60) to hold the call until the person presses Send or answers a request. 0 answers at once.

outputSchema.description: The person's actions after `after` (stored `act` lines, which include `grant` and `deny` answers to the caller's requests). `more` is true when `limit` cut the list. A wait that timed out answers `{ responses: [], head }` (api.md 31, 43).

tools.name: read_ledger
tools.title: Read raw ledger lines
tools.description: Read raw ledger lines after a position, oldest first, from every writer. Pass `after` (a `seq`, 0 for the start), `limit` (default 100, at most 500) and optionally `board` to keep only one board's lines. It returns JSON `{ events, head, more? }`, or just the lines as `application/jsonl` when you ask for that; a jsonl reader pages by the last line's `seq` and stops on an empty page. Use `check_responses` instead when you only want the person's answers.

limit.description: How many to return at most (default 100, at most 500).

tools.name: join
tools.title: Join as an agent
tools.description: Join the project as an agent and get your agent id and secret, once. Pass a short `label` such as "Pricing chat". Joining grants nothing: call `request_grant` for write access. Save `agent` and `secret` in your durable notes now, because a context compaction loses them and the secret cannot be read again; send it as `Authorization: Bearer <secret>` on your writes. If a write answers `not-authenticated`, join again and ask for your grants again. This is the one write that needs no credentials. Here you send the secret as the `secret` argument of `list_open`, `check_responses`, `request_grant`, `write_board`, or set `VB_AGENT_SECRET` when one identity serves every chat that shares this MCP configuration.

outputSchema.title: API: join answer
outputSchema.description: The agent id and its secret, shown once (api.md 21). The agent must save both in its durable notes (api.md 22).

tools.name: request_grant
tools.title: Ask for write access to a container
tools.description: Ask the person for write access to one container, named by `board` and `region`. Call it once when `write_board` answers `needs-grant`, with a `reason` so the person knows why; then wait for the answer in `check_responses` and resend the same items with the same keys. If you already have an open request for that container it is returned with `replayed: true`; if you already hold the container you get `{ held: true }`. Here the Bearer secret is the `secret` argument, the one `join` gave you; leave it out only when this MCP server was started with `VB_AGENT_SECRET`.

key.description: The agent's retry key, scoped to the agent across the project (api.md 13, 29)

outputSchema.title: API: request_grant answer
outputSchema.description: Either the open request (with `replayed: true` when one already stood, api.md 26) or `{ held: true }` when the caller already holds the container.

tools.name: write_board
tools.title: Write to a board
tools.description: Write to one board: draw boards, regions, nodes and links, and answer the person with replies, proposals and park bundles. Pass `items` (at most 200), run in order; each item has a `type`: `board`, `region`, `node`, `link`, `unlink`, `reply`, `propose` or `park`. Give each item a `key` so a retry never writes twice, and `base` (the version you read) on a node update so a stale edit fails. It answers 200 with one result per item, plus `head` and `pending` (items waiting for your answer). An item in a container you do not hold fails with `needs-grant`. You cannot decide an item: `propose` acknowledge or drop and the person decides. Here the Bearer secret is the `secret` argument, the one `join` gave you; leave it out only when this MCP server was started with `VB_AGENT_SECRET`.
